EntityProps.Name: Clause_Type
EntityProps.Comment: The Type of Clause, eg: Lease Protection: Lease Protection is used to indicate whether or not ell has Legal lease protection with Landlords or tenants – and whether or not either party is exempted from Lease Protection. This could apply to Shell & their Landlords, or with Shell tenants (i.e. on lease in or lease out contracts). Notification Method : Means of communicating notifications to business partner. This can be used by anyone (Legal Department Field Operators, PMC, PMA, etc) needing to send a legal notification, such as a contract renewal, termination, amendment, assignment or other legal communication. Overhold: Permitted Use: Purchase Option: An option in a lease agreement that allows the lesseo purchase the leased asset at the end of the lease period Subletting: Surrender/Restoration: Volume Letter: Volume Letter is used to indicate if there is a contual requirement to send a letter to Landlords certifying the final sales volume figures (this is not to be confused with the settlement letter with volumes). This is an additional letter beyond the settlement letter

The renewal option appears as a covenant in the original lease and provides specifications under which the leaseholder can renew or extend the original lease term for an additional, specified time and rate (rent). Termination Option: A clause in a lease that outlines the terms for ending an original lease agreement. the original lease term for an additional, specified time and rate (rent).

EntityProps.Name: Withholding_Tax
EntityProps.Comment:
Withholding tax is a portion of the lease payment taken immediately upon receipt by the government to be put toward the lessor's income tax for the year. Not every Vendor is liable for this.
This tax is deducted at the beginning of the payment flow. Typically, an amount is withheld and paid over or reported to the tax authorities on behalf of (as opposed to by) the person subject to tax, the exception being self-withholding tax. If a withholding tax exemption is available, withholding tax is not withheld. More than one withholding tax type can be assigned of to a business partner.
